method: Reuses the already-sourced approximate campus point for site:roque-de-los-muchachos-gamma-ray-array (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim geocode of 'Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos') verbatim as MAGIC's own reference point; no new coordinate is derived. MAGIC-I and MAGIC-II are published as 85 m apart (Wikipedia/public sources, not independently confirmed by a rank<=10 fetch this session) but this session could not fetch a primary source stating MAGIC's own precise coordinate or an OSM trace of the two dishes (Overpass refused every connection attempt), so the two telescopes are not resolved separately.
name: MAGIC telescopes (reference point, shared with CTAO-North)
notes: Identical coordinate to geometry:ctao-north-lst1-point -- expected to raise the validator's geometry-duplicate-shape warning; both experiments genuinely occupy this same approximate 500 m patch of the observatory and are not resolved to finer precision this session (see map notes and worklog).
